title: Injective model for global sections of the closed support object
statement:
Fix a finite commutative ring $A$. Let $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ be a closed immersion of schemes with quasi-compact complementary open immersion $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-closed-immersion, def-weil-open-immersion, def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Work with ordinary constant-$A$ module sheaves on the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules] and their derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], with exact $i_*$ and $i^*,j^*$ as in [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. Put $i^!_0M=i^*\ker(M\to j_*j^*M)$ [def-pur-flasque-support], and write $S=Ri^!_0$ on $D^+$, with its support counit $\epsilon:i_*SK\to K$ as in [lem-pur-support-localization-triangle]. The sheaf functor $i^!_0$ is right adjoint to the exact sheaf functor $i_*$ and preserves injective objects. For every bounded-below complex of injective $A_X$-module sheaves $I$ representing $K\in D^+(X_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$, the complex $i^!_0I$ is bounded below and termwise injective, represents $SK$, and computes its derived global sections. There is an equality of complexes, natural in chain maps of such representatives,
$$\Gamma(Z,i^!_0I)=\Gamma(X,i_*i^!_0I)=\ker\bigl(I(X)\to I(U)\bigr)=\Gamma_Z(X,I),$$
with all differentials induced by those of $I$. Consequently it induces a canonical natural isomorphism
$$R\Gamma(Z,SK)\xrightarrow{\sim}R\Gamma_Z(X,K)$$
in the derived category of $A$-modules. Here $\Gamma_Z$ is the kernel-of-restriction functor and $R\Gamma_Z$ its bounded-below right derived functor [def-pur-support-cohomology]; the isomorphism in degree $r\in\mathbf Z$ is an isomorphism of cohomology modules, not an identification with a sheaf.
